title: Activate a fresh project from the browser: measured receipts, no seed script
description:
Filed by architect-16a01670 from parent task-e7a3d643bde34da7b27495dbda745739 (epic breakdown, human-directed 2026-09-04).

PRODUCT GAP (README 'What this is not', re-measured 2026-09-04 at main d90ef6b5..68eb1c5d): a fresh project cannot be started from the browser alone. `goal.create_with_source` is refused until the activation chain commits, and only the seed script (`pnpm seed` = apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/demo-seed-main.ts) or the wrapper drives that chain. `apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/live-goal-create.ts:91-93` renders the sentence '... the browser cannot drive the pre-activation chain.' The seed FAKES the activation witness: `demo-seed-payloads.ts:127-137` activationWitness = {artifactPathRef/backupPathRef/credentialRef/signingKeyRef/storeDriverRef: '<projectId>-*' strings, distributionManifestHash: hex64('cafe'), policyRevisionHash: hex64('face'), providerMinimumProfileRef, truthClass: DEMO_VERIFIED}. Chain kinds on the daemon vocabulary (daemon-command-vocabulary.ts): project.register, project.bind_repository, provider.probe, project.activate, policy.install, policy.validate. Production writers: apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-sequence.ts, bootstrap-services.ts, bootstrap-contracts.ts; the seed's chain order is demo-seed-plan.ts; the browser already installs policy from the Policy screen (PR #16, control-room v2/ops/policy-install-port.ts re-reads /affordances/read per step).

FEATURE: the daemon mints the activation witness from MEASURED facts of the real project, and the browser drives the chain from one card.
Receipts: repository = `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` + HEAD sha of the project root (refuse when not a git repo); provider = a real probe of the installed agent CLI (`claude --version` / `codex --version`) plus credential PRESENCE from the launcher roster (orchestrator/moe-up-credentials.ts) as a ref, never a value; store = the daemon's own SQLite path + driver id; backup = a real copy of the store under `<project>/.moe-next/backups/<ts>.sqlite` with its sha256; distribution = the running artifact's manifest hash, or a SOURCE_CHECKOUT truth class under `pnpm start`; policy = the installed policy revision. truthClass is VERIFIED only for measured members; an unmeasurable member refuses the WHOLE activation with a stable code naming the member (fail closed; DEMO_VERIFIED never leaves the seed).

UI: the project setup board gets an 'Activate project' card listing each receipt as measured/missing with its reason; one button drives register -> bind_repository -> provider.probe -> project.activate sequentially (same pattern as policy-install-port.ts), refusals verbatim; New Goal enables afterwards. The manager flow (`moe projects` Create/Register) lands on the same card.

NOT in scope: signing keys as a trust boundary (security), changing the wrapper's own bootstrap path (keep it working), the seed script (keep it working).
definitionOfDone: From a FRESH store with no seed: browser-only register -> Activate project -> New Goal enabled -> goal.create_with_source ACCEPTED. Proven by a Playwright journey under tests/e2e/control-room/ against a REAL daemon (no fixtures; `pnpm test:e2e:browser` count line quoted) AND a live drive transcript (store path, sha, screenshots) in a row comment.

The daemon-written activation witness carries measured values (repo toplevel + HEAD sha, provider CLI version, store path, backup sha256) with truthClass VERIFIED; a test mutates each member to unmeasurable and asserts the refusal code + layer PER MEMBER (e.g. ACTIVATION_REPOSITORY_UNMEASURED, ACTIVATION_PROVIDER_UNMEASURED, ACTIVATION_BACKUP_FAILED); no production path can write a DEMO_VERIFIED witness (test asserts the code when a caller supplies one).

`grep -n "cannot drive the pre-activation chain" apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/live-goal-create.ts` = 0 matches at the delivered tree; the replacement copy names the Activate card; the card's testids are pinned in a control-room test.

`pnpm seed` keeps working unchanged: apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/demo-seed-*.test.ts green with the count line quoted, and the wrapper's bootstrap path untouched (grep of the seed chain order in demo-seed-plan.ts unchanged).
README 'What this is not' fresh-project sentence and docs/agent-stack-runbook.md 'New Goal remains disabled' paragraph rewritten to the measured truth in the same commit.
Gates quoted with their count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` (root lane).

QA rejected (reopen 1/3) on DoD 2's FIRST CLAUSE ONLY — "the witness must carry a measured provider CLI version" — and re-measured DoD 1/3/4/5/6 as PASS at HEAD f7ad50ee on a tree where every feature-owned path is clean (comment-8605a891). Row rail 1 makes this row accountable for the full slice, and the reject says land it here or SPIDR one child. So this session WILL modify files, and the verification steps below are re-run against the tree this session delivers, not against the one QA graded. I did not re-open the five PASS items; QA's re-measurement stands.

THE DEFECT, CONFIRMED INDEPENDENTLY AT THIS HEAD. `measureProvider` (activation-receipts-measure.ts:107-122) returns `measuredReceipt("provider", probeRef, credential.ref)`. `probeRef` is `ports.committedProbeRef()` — a ref to an already-committed `provider.probe` envelope — and `credential.ref` is presence only (`credential/claude/login-file`). Neither is a version. `git grep -n -- "--version" -- apps/daemon/src` finds the moe CLI's own version words, two demo-seed comments and the doctor's pnpm probe; nothing on the activation path. QA's reading is exact.

THREE MEASUREMENTS THAT SHAPE THE FIX, taken before writing a line:

(a) THE VERSION HAS NO HOME IN CORE'S NINE KEYS, so it cannot go in the witness object. `activationWitnessOf` (activation-receipts.ts:173-198) spends the provider receipt's TWO fields already: `providerMinimumProfileRef: provider.ref` and `credentialRef: provider.detail`. Both are load-bearing and neither is free. `provider.ref` in particular is compared for equality against the durable probe envelope at provider-profile-reader-checks.ts:192-193 (`revision.providerMinimumProfileRef !== witnessRef`), so appending `@<version>` to it would red that reader. The version therefore lands as a top-level member of the receipt SET, exactly parallel to `receipts.repository` (toplevel+headSha), `receipts.store` (storePath) and `receipts.distribution` — which is precisely how QA graded the other three measured values in DoD 2's own list. It must also be PUBLISHED, or it is measured and dropped: `live-activation.ts:27-28` carries an EXACT-KEY roster of the view, so the new key needs that roster, the decoder and the card, or the whole response is refused.

(b) THE HOST'S REAL CLI OUTPUT IS NOT BARE SEMVER. `claude --version` on this host answers `2.1.261 (Claude Code)`, one line with a trailing parenthetical. The doctor's existing `parseVersionOutput` (doctor-version.node.ts:110-118) demands EXACTLY one line matching `^\d+\.\d+\.\d+` and would have taken it, but a copy of that rule tuned to pnpm is the wrong thing to grow here; the parse is written against the measured output, per mem:gotcha-provider-launch-flags-need-real-cli-precedence-probe (a green parser suite can certify an invented CLI).

(c) THE WINDOWS SHIM IS THE REASON A NAIVE SPAWN WOULD REFUSE ON EVERY WINDOWS HOST. doctor-version.node.ts:93-96 records it: Node 24 cannot spawn `.cmd`/`.bat` with `shell:false`, and `claude` is a `.cmd` shim on Windows. The repo already owns the answer — `agentSpawnInvocation` (orchestrator/agent-spawn-invocation.ts:52) returns `{file,args,shell}` and builds the one quoted command line for win32. I will call that seam rather than write a second copy, so the CLI-absent refusal means "no CLI", never "Windows".

SCOPE I AM TAKING, and the one item I am NOT: QA's TO CLOSE lists six things. Five are in: measure the version in the daemon through injected ports (the measure module still spawns nothing — its own source-text arm scans it), `UNKNOWN` when the CLI answers unreadably, a CLI-absent refusal arm, drop the DEV_PAYLOADS invented literals, re-quote the gates. The sixth — "refuse a caller-supplied provider observation as ACTIVATION_WITNESS_CALLER_SUPPLIED does" — is measured and reported in step 3's note with the count that decides it; I am not deciding it here.
